why: A delivers the sober black and dark-wood study the client described: a black-brown desk, a black chair and lamp, and a genuinely low wide bookcase. Its only off-palette notes are the light bookcase top and the tan leather Poäng. B mixes medium walnut, reddish mahogany legs and a decorative half-moon bookcase that is neither low nor sober, and its 8 cm listed depth is doubtful, so the look is less cohesive.
